title: Energy-saving tip
description: Front matter of one tip file (content/tips/<id>.md). The Markdown body below the front matter holds the longer explanation.

id.description: Kebab-case slug; must equal the file name.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown on the card.

regions.description: Where the item applies. BE: all of Belgium (federal rules, or advice that holds everywhere). Otherwise one or more regions as ISO 3166-2 codes: BE-VLG (Flanders), BE-BRU (Brussels), BE-WAL (Wallonia).

kind.description: practice: something to do; explainer: a rule or concept explained (EPB, EPC, rental rules); service: a pointer to an existing tool or service, such as Mijn VerbouwPremie or the Energiehuis.

stage.description: Where the reader is with their home.

stability.description: constant: good practice that barely changes with new laws, prices or services. variable: depends on rules, premiums, tariffs, prices or a service that can change; needs review_by, and readers are told to check the source before acting.

review_by.description: Required when stability is variable: the date by which the tip must be checked again. The build warns once it has passed, and the site says the tip is overdue for a check.

rung.description: The effort ladder. 1 habit: a change in routine, nothing to buy; 2 quick fix: an afternoon of DIY; 3 upgrade: one product or one technician visit; 4 renovation: one building element with a contractor; 5 deep renovation: several elements, an architect, EPB rules apply. Set by hand: cost and time are shown separately.

time_needed.description: Rough time to do it: minutes; hours (an afternoon); days; weeks or months.

upfront_cost.description: Upfront cost in euro: none (€0), under €100, €100–2,500, €2,500–25,000, over €25,000.

basis.description: What the number assumes and where it comes from.

impact.description: How much energy the item saves in a typical Flemish house in a year. See content/README.md, 'Impact bands'.

band.description: large: about 1,000 kWh a year or more; medium: about 250-1,000 kWh; small: under about 250 kWh; unrated: the sources give no size; indirect: saves no energy by itself (a rule, service, money or health item).

basis.description: Required for large, medium and small: the cited figure and how it gives the band.

energy.description: Which energy the saving is in, in the reference house (heated with natural gas). Required for large, medium and small.

kwh.description: The yearly saving in kWh from impact.basis, if it gives one (the top of the range when kwh_min is set). The site turns it into kg of CO2 and tree equivalents.

kwh_min.description: When impact.basis gives a range, its lower end; kwh is then the upper end.

up_to.description: true when kwh is an upper limit ("up to").

per.description: When kwh is per square metre of glazing or per lamp rather than per home.

payback.description: Only when a cited source states a payback time. Requires stability: variable, because payback depends on prices.

source.description: Index (from 0) of the source in sources that states the payback time.

responsibility.description: Who normally acts or pays: the tenant, an owner living in the home, the landlord, or tenant and landlord together.

pairs_with.description: Ids of tips to do together with this one, or first; for example ventilation when sealing draughts.

type.description: official: government, regulator or grid operator; consumer-organisation: e.g. Test-Aankoop; commercial: companies, banks, comparison sites; media: news outlets. research: a study, report or paper; cite it inside the tip it supports.

url.description: Exact page URL (not a home page).

accessed.description: Date the link and the cited content were last checked.

locator.description: Where on the page or document the cited content is (section heading, page and tip number).

supports.description: Which claim or figure in this tip this source backs.

sources.description: Every tip needs at least one source. Write the tip in your own words; the source is where readers go for the full detail.

status.description: verified: every claim is backed by a cited source; needs-check: at least one open point. A tip with any {nocite} marker or no-citation flag can't be 'verified'.

flags.description: Open points for readers and reviewers. Shown on the tip page while status is not 'verified'.

type.description: no-citation: part of the tip is not backed by any cited source (mark those sentences with {nocite} in the body); secondary-source: backed only by a commercial or media source; to-verify: something to double-check (dates, yearly figures, eligibility).

lang.description: Language of title/summary/body, e.g. en, nl.
